title: Streamer Arc
tagline: Livestream donation alert platform for creators with web2 friendly features
description:
This project allows livestreamers and content creators to receive donations from their audience without any commissions or fees. The best part the creator does not need a crypto wallet they can simply use Google sign in and get a Circle wallet.

On the donator side, the user can donate using USDC on any network and the USDC is bridged automagically using CCTP to Arc Testnet in the creator's wallet and an alert is shown on the creator's stream!
how_its_made:
I used Circle wallet to enable the livestreamers to be onboarded without any wallet. 

I used CCTP to bridge USDC from any supported network donated by the audience to Arc testnet where the creator receives their donations.

I am using ENS for human readable names on the livestream

I am also using server-side events for alerts and Browser voice api for dictation.
